headline: Warden Raid Flips Fisherman's Row as Fierce Attrition Grips Interior
war_summary: The past three hours brought a sudden shift on the western periphery, where Warden forces stormed and secured Fort Ember in Fisherman's Row, logging the war's latest territorial turnover. Meanwhile, the intense base exchanges across Linn of Mercy and Stonecradle have momentarily slowed, yet both sectors continue to endure severe attrition, logging two-hour casualty totals exceeding three thousand and forty-eight hundred men, respectively. Heavy bloodletting persists unabated in Weathered Expanse, where nearly four thousand fallen were reported in two hours despite a lull in base transitions. To the north, Nevish Line has abruptly flared into intense action, absorbing nearly twenty-four hundred casualties in the latest watch, while Stlican Shelf and Marban Hollow sustain heavy, accelerating engagements along their contested borders. With Callahan's Passage cooling substantially after earlier clashes, the focal points of conflict remain centered upon the battered northern interior and the newly contested western waters.
